worldcombat.skill.supersonic.summary: Pushes a ring of sound out from the body, sweeping the ground all around; anything the wave front crosses is left confused, so its actions may be wasted and its own force turns on it. The pulse is not aimed and passes through walls — running out of the front is the safe play.
worldcombat.skill.supersonic.use.0: Disrupt a whole circle when surrounded
worldcombat.skill.supersonic.use.1: Push back several targets that crowd the user
worldcombat.skill.supersonic.use.2: Open a collective miss window in a brawl
worldcombat.skill.supersonic.description: The pulse expands from the user: radius %1$s blocks, the front advancing %2$s blocks per tick; anything the front passes over is caught.
Caught enemies are left confused for %1$s: each action may be wasted, and a landed hit turns their own force back on them.

Pushing out the pulse takes %1$s, the recovery is %2$s and the cooldown %3$s. The band is a choice: Wide multiplies the radius by 1.3 but confuses for less time (x0.8); Focus shrinks it to x0.7 with a x1.1 cooldown, buying x1.3 confusion and +1 severity.
Wide: radius x1.3 and broader coverage, but confusion duration x0.8 — good for opening up when surrounded. Focus: radius x0.7 and cooldown x1.1, buying x1.3 duration and +1 severity — good for dazing one target at close range.
The partner only considers the pulse while a threat is this close; smaller keeps it for melee range, larger lets it chase out.
When swarmed: sound only with at least two enemies close, or right after the partner is hit. Anytime: sound on a single threat as pure disruption.
When on, the partner will also leave its post to sound.
